context_no-partitions: There are no partitions to display
context_window: 'now' is the latest measurement, '30 s' and '10 min' are exponential averages with the corresponding half-life
context_single-window: The metric is always averaged over the heavy-hitters window of the computation, 5 minutes by default
hint_cpu_usage: CPU used by the job of a partition and its companion process.
hint_memory_usage: Heap held by the job of a partition and its companion process.
hint_messages_per_second: Messages read from the input streams of a partition; zero for computations without input streams.
hint_bytes_per_second: Bytes read from the input streams of a partition; zero for computations without input streams.
